seoTitle: Capital Row, for owners of software with a services arm: two businesses in one transaction, and the software leads your price
seoDescription: For owners of software businesses with a services arm: the discount on services sits in revenue multiples far more than in earnings multiples.

sections.name: Two businesses in one transaction. The software leads your price.

items.text: Two businesses in one transaction. The software leads your price.
The discount on services shows up in revenue multiples far more than in earnings multiples. If your services are profitable, that is a position you can take before a process starts.
trailing revenue is the median for health IT software vendors. For outsourced services providers it is 2.8 times. On earnings, the two medians are 16.6 and 14.5 times.

A healthcare technology advisory firm’s market review, July 2026: global M&A and buyout transactions, 2021 to the first half of 2026. Medians of enterprise value to revenue and enterprise value to EBITDA, as published.

items.text: A services arm is the first thing a buyer separates out. Separate it first.
A services arm is not a problem. The split decides whether you are priced as software or as a services business with a product.
Against 30 percent on professional services and 77 percent for the whole company, with services at about 15 percent of revenue at the median.
Revenue multiple paid for a listed vertical software company with a large outsourced services arm
Acquired whole in the second quarter of 2026, at 8.1 times earnings and an enterprise value of $557M.
Where practitioners put the services share that changes how you are priced
Two sources published in 2026 say 15 to 20 percent and 30 to 35 percent. Neither has a dataset behind it, and nobody publishes realized multiples by services share.
Annual recurring revenue excludes one-time fees and professional services, even where they recur.

Benchmarkit, 583 companies, May 2025. A healthcare technology advisory firm’s market review, July 2026. SaaS Metrics Standards Board. The services-share thresholds are practitioner opinion, reported as such.

Capital Row is the M&A firm that reads your numbers the way a buyer will, before you go to market. Every figure traced to a source document, every adjustment marked supported or unsupported, and the findings are yours to keep.
Scope and fee are agreed in writing before any work begins. Nothing from your review reaches a buyer, or anyone else, without your written permission.
